comment: The reviewed mapping from every question in answer-book/papers/*.json to the card that answers it. ONE ROW PER PAPER SLOT (per part, where a Section-C question prints two tasks) — 147 rows, no exceptions, because a half-processed paper is the failure this file exists to prevent. resolution "card" = an authored card answers it. "gap" = the unit IS built and nothing answers it, so it is the authoring queue. "unbuilt" = the unit is not in units.json at all, which is a known counted state and never an error. Confirmed by hand against the card index on 2026-08-26; no row here was written by a similarity score. src/scripts/backtest_ipe_papers.ts re-derives every claim in this file from the bank and fails if one stops being true.
